args.description: one single large leather bag tied with cord, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. A round bulging sack of stitched tan oxhide with visible seams, its neck gathered and bound tight with several turns of pale silver cord knotted at the front, the leather creased where it is tied, a faint pale spiral pattern branded on the side, resting on its base. Warm palette of tan leather, dark brown seams and pale silver cord. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
